title: Planning an oral-history recording session
passage:
M: Maya and Theo can both come early or late. Maya needs the interpreter for her interview. Theo wants help with a run-through of his notes, but our interpreter can only stay for the early slot.
F: The interpreter can work with two people in a joint interview. A run-through is a separate booking, though.
M: Right. I’ll ask if they’re willing to interview together. Can we still record Theo’s run-through?
F: Yes, if it’s just members in the room. Maya is a guest; her form covers her interview, but not a run-through.
M: Lin’s sorting the recordings. The recorder puts every file in the same folder. How will she tell what’s what?
F: Say “interview” or “run-through” at the start of each recording. Tell Lin not to go by the file times. Those show when we copied the files, not when we recorded them.
passageZh:
M: 瑪雅和西奧都可以早一點或晚一點來。瑪雅受訪時需要口譯。西奧想找人幫他順一遍筆記，不過口譯員只能留在較早的時段。
F: 如果兩人一起受訪，口譯員可以同時協助他們。不過彩排要另外預約。
M: 好，我問問他們願不願意一起受訪。那西奧的彩排還能錄音嗎？
F: 可以，只要房間裡都是會員。瑪雅是來賓，她簽的表單只涵蓋正式訪談，不包括彩排。
M: 琳在整理錄音檔。錄音機會把所有檔案放在同一個資料夾，她怎麼分辨？
F: 每次開始錄音時，先說「訪談」或「彩排」。提醒琳不要看檔案時間，那是我們複製檔案的時間，不是錄音時間。
